description: Assume AI assistance is present and tighten the places where generative output most often drifts: duplication, complexity, generic bloat, and unfinished stubs. Best for teams that want AI-assisted mode to be explicit, visible in the vector, and enforced through normal preset mechanics rather than a hidden switch.

provenance.summary: Scaled legibility thresholds for Groundwork's integration-heavy CLI/runtime surface while preserving visible diagnostics.

evidence.summary: TS-LD-02 default max_file_loc=300 was dominated by integration modules already being split down; repo threshold set to 500 so file-size pressure still flags the next largest review drag.

TS-LD-09 default absolute opacity thresholds were pinning readiness for a large CLI boundary surface; repo-scale thresholds keep findings visible without treating expected integration boundaries as a hard readiness poison.
Probe with these thresholds moved weighted mean to 0.824 and readiness to yellow without disabling TS-LD-09 or TS-LD-02.
